guide.title: E.T.C.'s Overview
guide.text:
E.T.C. is a disruptive but moderately durable Tank.
Teammates will find his outstanding ability to engage
and peel valuable, however, his limited damage output means that
E.T.C. players must work well with allied Heroes in order to secure kills.

guide.title: E.T.C.'s Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Ability to engage from medium distance
Some mobility to get out of danger
Huge amount of crowd control
Opportunity to become global at Level 10
Weaknesses
Relatively low damage output
Not as durable as most Tanks
Low waveclear

guide.title: E.T.C.'s Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
E.T.C. synergizes with
E.T.C.'s aggressive crowd control-oriented Ability set makes him
particularly useful to any Hero who is able to follow up on said
crowd control with powerful damaging and/or crowd controlling Abilities.
If you pair E.T.C. with a Hero who, like him, is capable of playing as either
Tank and Offlaner, you can keep
E.T.C. in the 4-man until Stage Dive gets unlocked and then swap.
Healers who can provide Unstoppable
during Mosh Pit (such as Kharazim with Cleansing Touch)
are great to deny enemy interrupts which will otherwise shut it down.
E.T.C. is countered by
E.T.C. struggles against Heroes who can easily dodge,
quickly interrupt, or completely ignore
his crowd control Abilities.

guide.title: E.T.C.'s Maps
guide.text:
E.T.C.'s stronger maps
E.T.C.'s average maps
E.T.C.'s weaker maps
Having a well-rounded Ability set, E.T.C. works well on most Maps
but performs better where he can flank—to
Face Melt and then Powerslide
as a safe engage—or fight near
choke points—where he can easily hit
enemy Heroes with Powerslide and his Heroic Abilities.
Battlefield of Eternity is particularly interesting
for E.T.C. because he can knockback
and Stun enemy Heroes right below
the allied Immortal to make it impossible for them to dodge his Abilities.
While it is not necessarily a huge problem depending on the rest of your draft,
E.T.C. is not that good for Maps where the Objective takes extremely long
to be secured because, even if he has some self-sustain,
he will struggle to be alive for long due to his below-average durability.

guide.title: E.T.C.'s Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
When dangerous to go forward, use Powerslide from the side of the enemy Hero you intend to Stun, possibly more towards allied Heroes than enemy Heroes.
Face Melt is a great tool to peel or interrupt stationary-channeled Abilities.
Guitar Solo is the least important Ability at your disposal, thus being great for triggering Rockstar to mitigate incoming damage.
Mentally track of enemy crowd control Abilities so that Mosh Pit does not get interrupted.
Stage Dive allows you to quickly join your team when playing E.T.C. as Offlaner and/or to dive together with other allied Heroes.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: E.T.C.'s Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
E.T.C. is a disruptive Tank as he provides
a huge amount of crowd control
which can be used to peel or engage.
Thanks to his versatile kit, E.T.C. can be used as either an aggressive
or defensive Tank, depending on the draft and based on the situation.
Not being extremely durable, E.T.C. has to be careful when going for aggressive plays,
making sure that his team is ready to follow-up
and being confident that the chosen move will translate to an advantage,
otherwise he may end up dying for no reason and thus leaving his team
without a key component for multiple seconds.
If your team drafted accordingly, E.T.C. can be played
as an Offlaner. Even better,
if the main Tank is capable of solo laning,
you may put E.T.C. in the 4-man until Level 10 and then switch them
once Stage Dive gets unlocked.

abilities.title: E.T.C.'s Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
When dangerous to go forward, use Powerslide from the side of the enemy Hero you intend to Stun, possibly more towards allied Heroes than enemy Heroes.
Face Melt is a great tool to peel or interrupt stationary-channeled Abilities.
Guitar Solo is the least important Ability at your disposal, thus being great for triggering Rockstar to mitigate incoming damage.
Mentally track of enemy crowd control Abilities so that Mosh Pit does not get interrupted.
Stage Dive allows you to quickly join your team when playing E.T.C. as Offlaner and/or to dive together with other allied Heroes.

abilities.title: Powerslide
abilities.text:
Powerslide
(Q)
E.T.C.
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Slide to a location dealing 105 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning enemies hit for 1.25 seconds.
Powerslide is E.T.C.'s defining Ability. On its own, it provides a reliable
area of effect Stun to initiate,
peel, and interrupt
channeled Abilities.
Powerslide should generally be used as a setup tool
for allied Heroes and their Abilities (such as Blizzard by Jaina).
Avoid using Face Melt immediately after Powerslide
or you will cause allied Heroes to miss their skillshot Abilities.
The lengthy dash allows
you to quickly position yourself behind enemy Heroes to
body block them out of an escape route, or between
allied and enemy Heroes to reduce their effectiveness in team fight.
When in danger, you can also use Powerslide to run away.
As Powerslide is both your only engage
and escape tool, you have to think twice before using it aggressively,
else you may end up being surrounded by enemy Heroes and die for no reason.
To avoid that, try to use Powerslide from a side to the other
or from the middle towards your team, usually done by flanking.
E.T.C.'s presence alone is often enough to control aggression,
particularly when opponents know full well that Powerslide is available,
especially after Level 10 because its Stun effectively allows you
to fully channel Mosh Pit
with no possibility of escape.

abilities.title: Face Melt
abilities.text:
Face Melt
(W)
E.T.C.
Mana: 55
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Deals 68 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back.
Face Melt is a Basic Ability that can be used
to knockback all enemies nearby. Including a daze,
this effect will also interrupt any
stationary-channeled Ability being performed by them.
You can use Face Melt to move enemy Heroes and Mercenaries
where you want them to be. In case of Heroes, it can be used to knock them
towards your team right after a flank
as a setup for a safer Powerslide.
In case of Mercenaries, it can be used to knock them
into the range of your Structures, thus making it way easier to take them down
as they will help you with powerful shots.
A nice tech to know is that you can use Face Melt
to make enemy Heroes unable to dodge Powerslide
because they cannot do anything while affected by a daze.
Keep this in mind when playing against enemy Heroes who have mobility tools
at their disposal, especially if they tend to play in melee range (such as Zeratul).
While standing between allied and enemy Heroes, the
knockback effect will create a protective buffer zone to give
your team breathing room, especially against melee Heroes who lack mobility
and do not have reliable tools to close the gap again (for example Artanis).

abilities.title: Guitar Solo
abilities.text:
Guitar Solo
(E)
E.T.C.
Mana: 40
Cooldown: 9 seconds
Regenerate 66 (+4% per level) Health per second for 4 seconds.
Guitar Solo is a Basic Ability that gives E.T.C.
some self-sustain, helping him stay in the action for longer.
Over time, it allows him to heal some poke damage.
Guitar Solo is the best way
to trigger Rockstar
when you do not want to spend important cooldowns but need extra survivability.

abilities.title: Mosh Pit
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Mosh Pit
(R)
E.T.C.
Heroic
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 120 seconds
After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.
Mosh Pit is a Heroic Ability that,
after a short cast time,
can be stationary-channeled
to Stun enemies within its area.
When you pick Mosh Pit at Level 10,
it is important to mentally track the cooldown of enemy Abilities
that can interrupt it, otherwise
you may end up wasting an extremely long cooldown for no reason.
If you catch Heroes who still have interrupts available
with Powerslide, then you do not have to worry about them anymore
because casting Mosh Pit immediately after
will surely Stun them with literally no time to react.
If you see a good opportunity to kill an enemy Hero and then get value from that,
do not hesitate to use Mosh Pit for blocking
a single enemy Hero and allow your team to take them down.
Just make sure that the enemy team does not have single-target tools
to counter that play, in which case your plan should be to catch
at least 2 Heroes inside Mosh Pit.
Like any crowd control effect,
Mosh Pit can also be used to try to momentarily
prevent powerful defensive Abilities (such as
Divine Shield Uther) from being used
while the rest of your team focuses down a specific target.
In theory, players should pay attention to both sound effect and animation,
however, there are some players who do not rely on sound clues.
As a consequence, in some rare occasions you can use a peculiar trick:
Dance with [Y] or Mount with [Z] to make the opponents think you are casting Mosh Pit.
The difference is that using Dance cannot be stopped by damage whereas
using Mount shows a channel in progress to your enemies.

abilities.title: Stage Dive
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Stage Dive
(R)
E.T.C.
Heroic
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 75 seconds
Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 495 (+4.0% per level) damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.
Though seldom used mid-combat due to its 1.25-second
cast time, Stage Dive is
useful as an initiation tool thanks to its lengthy and
potent Slow. On its own, this Heroic Ability may be enough
to force an enemy team to split up or use mobility Abilities
in order to avoid its effect as they will see its indicator on the ground.
This allows your own team to capitalize on the precarious position of your opponents.
Stage Dive can also be used as a last resort escape, though this is not
recommended due to its relatively long cooldown. It should be noted that the
Ability's initial 1.5-second channeling time
can be interrupted, as with all channeled Abilities.
E.T.C goes into Stasis while in the air,
something that allows you to use Stage Dive
as a defensive tool against powerful damaging Abilities
which deal damage to their target after a while (such as
Last Rites by Malthael) or that follow
the Hero model (for example Pyroblast by Kael'thas),
but only if you have enough time to cast Stage Dive
before they hit you, if you do not get interrupted.

abilities.title: Rockstar
abilities.text:
Rockstar
(D)
E.T.C.
Using a Basic Ability grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Heroic Abilities grant 50 Armor.
Rockstar is a Trait that makes E.T.C.
more resistant to incoming damage by providing a low amount of
Armor after using Basic Abilities
and a high amount of Armor when using Heroic Abilities.
While Face Melt and Guitar Solo
activate your Trait immediately, Powerslide only does so
when E.T.C stops sliding, Mosh Pit needs to be successfully cast,
and Stage Dive gives Armor after ETC lands.
Keep that in mind when you need immediate protection.

Guitar Hero
(Level 1)
E.T.C.
While Guitar Solo is active, E.T.C. heals for 60% of his damage dealt by Basic Attacks. Basic Attacks increase the duration of Guitar Solo by 0.5 seconds.
Guitar Hero is a good Talent which provides
a moderate amount of self-sustain
while hitting enemies with Basic Attacks during Guitar Solo,
regardless of them being Heroes or not.
In addition to that, it also extends the duration of
Guitar Solo by a considerable amount,
allowing you get more value from other Talents which empower it.
We find this Talent quite powerful while laning and in prolonged team fights,
but pretty much useless against burst damage. Furthermore,
since it works off Basic Attacks, it is countered
by Blinds.

(Level 1)
E.T.C.

Reward: After gathering 20 Regeneration Globes, Guitar Solo also heals nearby allied Heroes for 50 (+4% per level) Health every second while it is active.
Prog Rock is a strong Quest-based Talent
that provides a reasonable and reliable amount of
self sustain for each Regeneration Globe collected,
and, after getting 20 of them during the course of the game, this effect is
also extended to allied Heroes, making it an effective counter to some amount of
poke damage and just generally good for recuperating
Health.

(Level 1)
E.T.C.
Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes a stack of Block, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next Hero Basic Attack for 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Maximum 2 stacks of Block.
Block Party is a strong Talent which gives
you and nearby allied Heroes Physical Armor
in the form of Block charges
every time you use an Ability, including Heroic Abilities.
Block charges are especially valuable
when facing Heroes with slow but heavy-hitting Basic Attacks (such as Hanzo) and
terrible when playing against Heroes with fast-hitting Basic Attacks (D.Va,
Genji, Kharazim, Lúcio, Tassadar, Tracer,
and Tychus). Heroes with Clones (for example Nova) can consume them faster
too, however, it is generally not a problem because their AI will not always target you.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for E.T.C.
talent_pages.text:
?
Crowd Surfer
(Level 4)
E.T.C.
Allows Powerslide to travel over walls and terrain. If no enemies are hit, reduce the cooldown by 6 seconds and refund the Mana cost.
Crowd Surfer is a situational Talent
that allows E.T.C. to pass through otherwise impassable terrain,
giving him extra defensive and aggressive opportunities
in narrow areas (for example on Cursed Hollow),
and reduces the cooldown of Powerslide
when it doesn't hit anyone.
You may need this Talent when facing enemy Heroes who have access to tools
capable of stopping your Powerslide
mid-animation (such as Penetrating Round
by Raynor), so that it will be usable again
before what they used to stop you.
Consider going for this Talent when playing against Heroes
who can block your path (such as Tassadar
with Force Wall) or who can
move you behind the enemy Gate (notably Stitches
with Gorge),
so that you can avoid being stuck in a dangerous position.
✔
Loud Speakers
(Level 4)
E.T.C.
Increases Face Melt range and knockback by 50%.
Loud Speakers is a strong Talent that
significantly increases the range of Face Melt,
allowing you to make plays that would be otherwise impossible.
You can use this Talent to split the enemy team,
to better peel for allied Heroes,
to save yourself from danger, or to have more range for
interrupting enemy Abilities.
We find this Talent particularly useful against Heroes
who need to get close enough before being able to use their
Abilities (notably Garrosh and Valeera),
especially if you have Mic Check at Level 13.
?
Speed Metal
(Level 4)
E.T.C.
Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes 20% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.
Speed Metal is a good Talent which,
when using Abilities, provides a constant
and solid Movement Speed buff
to E.T.C. and nearby allied Heroes.
Movement Speed gives both offensive and defensive utility:
it helps with Basic Attacks uptime,
positioning, body-blocking, escaping,
and avoiding skillshot-based Abilities.
Consider picking this Talent when you have gone for Guitar Hero
at Level 1 and are planning to go for Hammer-on at Level 7
as it helps you to stick on enemy Heroes while hitting them with Basic Attacks.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for E.T.C.
talent_pages.text:
✔
Pinball Wizard
(Level 7)
E.T.C.
Hitting an enemy with Powerslide causes the next Face Melt against them within 2 seconds to deal 300% more damage.
Pinball Wizard is a strong Talent that
greatly increases the damage done by Face Melt
if it deals damage within 2 seconds after Powerslide
hit the same target.
As a general rule, you should wait for Powerslide's
Stun to end before using Face Melt,
even when having Pinball Wizard. The 2-second window
is more than enough for letting allied Heroes follow up
with their skillshot-based Abilities.
When really needed, Pinball Wizard can also be used for
clearing Minions and Mercenaries in lane. Just make sure that there are
no enemy Heroes nearby before wasting all your survivability tools like that
and that you will not need them to fight in the next dozen of seconds.
Stage Dive requires you to have Powerslide
ready to use at any moment, so you cannot waste it for clearing Minions and
Mercenaries. As a consequence, if you are playing E.T.C. as Offlaner
and thus plan to pick Stage Dive later on,
you should avoid picking Pinball Wizard.
?
Hammer-on
(Level 7)
E.T.C.
E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks deal 12% more damage, increased to 36% while Guitar Solo is active.
Hammer-on is a good Talent that passively
empowers your Basic Attacks and further increases their damage
while Guitar Solo is active.
If you want to empower this Talent, you can go for
Guitar Hero at Level 1
to increase its duration by up to 7 seconds,
from 4 seconds to a maximum of 11 seconds
when you are allowed to constantly use Basic Attacks.
Furthermore, the fact it increases the damage you deal
with Basic Attacks means you will get more healing
from Guitar Hero at Level 1.
Keep in mind that Blinds can be used to
counter this Talent as it works off
Basic Attacks. When that is the case, consider replacing it
with either Pinball Wizard or
Echo Pedal.
?
Echo Pedal
(Level 7)
E.T.C.
Using a Basic or Heroic Ability releases two pulses of 18 (+4% per level) damage. This deals 200% bonus damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. The first occurs instantly, the second occurs 2 seconds later.
Echo Pedal is a situational Talent which boosts your waveclear
after using any Ability, allowing you to easily kill enemy Minions and Mercenaries.
The first pulse happens immediately, the second one is delayed.
While clearing Minions and Mercenaries, wait for the second pulse before casting
another Ability, otherwise you will waste damage.
We recommend this Talent when playing E.T.C. as Offlaner
because it allows you to get rid of enemy Minions and Mercenaries by using Guitar Solo
and Face Melt, especially if you have Mic Check at Level 13
and Aggressive Shredding at Level 16 respectively for cooldown reduction.
This way you will be able to keep Powerslide off cooldown,
available for offensive or defensive usage immediately after landing with Stage Dive.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for E.T.C.
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Mosh Pit
(Level 10)
E.T.C.
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 120 seconds
After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.
Mosh Pit is a strong Heroic Ability even when the enemy team
has multiple interrupts at their disposal, however,
in that case it will be harder to use because you will need to mentally track
their cooldowns and only use Mosh Pit when none capable
of interrupting it will be nearby, outside of its area.
The best interrupts for Mosh Pit are ranged ones
(for example Wave of Force by Li-Ming)
because Heroes who can stay at a distance are not easy to catch,
especially if they also have mobility tools.
So, when facing many of them, you will have a hard time finding a good
Mosh Pit during the game, however, the enemy team will
still have to constantly respect it by saving interrupts
and by positioning accordingly.
If you get interrupted during the initial wind-up,
Mosh Pit will go on a 10-second cooldown.
Encore at Level 13 can also reduce that
cooldown, however, smart opponents will first let you successfully
cast Mosh Pit and then interrupt it.
?
Stage Dive
(Level 10)
E.T.C.
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 75 seconds
Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 495 (+4.0% per level) damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.
Stage Dive is a good Heroic Ability which
can be picked for one or more of the following reasons:
the enemy team has too many ways to play around Mosh Pit
and you don't want to risk it;
your team has another main Tank
and you have planned to play E.T.C. as Offlaner,
at least after Level 10;
your team wants to dive the enemy
backline to exploit their vulnerability;
the enemy team has powerful targeted Abilities which can be dodged
with the Invulnerable frames you get while in the air.
When playing Stage Dive as main Tank,
it is extremely important to stay with your team and not split
to soak like you would do when playing
Stage Dive as an Offlaner instead.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for E.T.C.
talent_pages.text:
✔
Mic Check
(Level 13)
E.T.C.
Hitting at least 2 targets with Face Melt reduces its cooldown by 6 seconds.
Mic Check is a strong Talent which heavily reduces
the cooldown of Face Melt when hitting multiple enemies
with a single cast.
You should pick this Talent when you need extra peeling
for your team. If you see that team fights are not lasting more than 5 seconds,
however, you may want to avoid this Talent as it will rarely give you value.
Loud Speakers at Level 4 is quite important to have
when planning to go for this Talent later on, else you will rarely be able
to hit multiple Heroes with it.
The cooldown reduction provided will help you getting more value from
Face Melt, Rockstar, and all related Talents.
A less obvious benefit of this Talent is the ability to cheaply and frequently
trigger Echo Pedal at Level 7, which is great when playing
as Offlaner.
?
Encore
(Level 13)
E.T.C.
Face Melt leaves an Amp behind, which will knock enemies away again 2 seconds later.
Passive: Each enemy Hero hit by Face Melt or the Amp reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 4%.
Encore is a good Talent that provides
a powerful cooldown reduction effect for your Heroic Abilities
(4% corresponds to 4.8 seconds for Mosh Pit
and 3 seconds for Stage Dive) when hitting
enemy Heroes with Face Melt. In addition to that,
it also provides a second pulse of Face Melt after a short delay.
The second pulse reduces your Heroic Ability's cooldown too.
If you do not need more peeling tools
to protect allied Heroes, you can take Encore
to greatly decrease your Heroic Ability's cooldown.
The cooldown reduction also works on the 10-second cooldown you get on
Mosh Pit when interrupted during
the initial wind-up, however, smart opponents will first let you successfully
cast Mosh Pit and then interrupt it.
Loud Speakers at Level 4 only increases the radius
of the first hit but will help you hit multiple enemy Heroes with the first hit.
On the other hand, when not having Loud Speakers at Level 4
you will be able to hit same Hero with both the first and second hit
by using Face Melt at melee distance and
Powerslide on them immediately after.
When having this Talent, do not cast Mosh Pit right
after using Face Melt in the same spot, otherwise the
second pulse may Knocback enemy Heroes out of it
and therefore free them from the continuous Stun.
?
Face Smelt
(Level 13)
E.T.C.
Face Melt Slows enemies by 50%, decaying over 2 seconds.
Face Smelt is a decent Talent that empowers
the already strong Face Melt by making it
apply a decaying Slow to all enemy Heroes hit.
Consider picking this Talent when having picked Guitar Hero
at Level 1 and Hammer-on at Level 7
as it helps you with sticking on enemy Heroes while hitting them with Basic Attacks,
or in synergy with allied Heroes who benefit from Slows
(such as Raynor with Ace In The Hole at Level 1).

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for E.T.C.
talent_pages.text:
✔
Show Stopper
(Level 16)
E.T.C.
After using Powerslide, gain 35 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing all damage taken by 35%.
Show Stopper is a strong Talent which gives you
a fair amount of Armor for a few seconds
after Powerslide's animation ends.
If you find yourself getting inexplicably bursted down too often after
initiating fights, Show Stopper is there to provide you
with all necessary added survivability.
Since you already get 20 Armor from Rockstar
and considering that Armor does not stack additively with other sources,
Show Stopper basically gives you 15 Armor on top of it.
All that said, do not underestimate its value because Armor gets exponentially
more powerful the higher it becomes.
?
Aggressive Shredding
(Level 16)
E.T.C.
E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Guitar Solo by 0.75 seconds.
Aggressive Shredding is a decent Talent that increases your
self-sustain by significantly improving Guitar Solo's
uptime, but only when you get to use Basic Attacks uncontested.
The cooldown reduction provided will help you getting more value from
Guitar Solo, Rockstar, and all related Talents.
A less obvious benefit of this Talent is the ability to cheaply and frequently
trigger Echo Pedal at Level 7, which is great when playing
as Offlaner.
?
Imposing Presence
(Level 16)
E.T.C.
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.
Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.
Imposing Presence is a situational Talent that passively
reduces the Attack Speed of enemy Heroes attacking E.T.C. and, when activated,
applies a Slow and reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy Heroes and Summons.
We find this Talent useful when facing Heroes with Summons
(for example Raynor with Raynor's Raider at Level 10),
when playing against Heroes with high Attack Speed
(such as Tracer), or when the enemy team features Heroes with Basic Attacks
that can hit multiple times (so D.Va, Genji, and Lúcio).

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for E.T.C.
talent_pages.text:
?
Tour Bus
(Level 20)
E.T.C.
Channeling Mosh Pit refreshes Powerslide's cooldown, and it can be cast to increase Mosh Pit's duration by 2 seconds.
Tour Bus is a situational Talent
that makes Mosh Pit extremely
punishing against teams that lack the interruption
to deal with the channel. In some occasions, however,
you can use the free Powerslide to dodge interrupts.
Use it to catch more enemy Heroes than you typically would
by only using the regular Mosh Pit instead,
as the Powerslide reset feature gives you a second chance
to hit enemy Heroes you missed.
When having this Talent, you can even cast a Mosh Pit
that hits no one in the beginning and then move it on top of enemy Heroes
thanks to the free Powerslide you will get when it starts.
?
Crowd Pleaser
(Level 20)
E.T.C.
Stage Dive's impact area is 50% bigger, and its Slow is increased by 30%.
Crowd Pleaser is a good Talent that turns Stage Dive into
an absolutely fearsome engage tool. With such a wide area of effect, it
becomes difficult for everyone to avoid the Ability. In addition to that,
its Slow will be more potent than before.
?
Death Metal
(Level 20)
E.T.C.
Upon dying, a ghost uses Mosh Pit at E.T.C's location.
Death Metal is an extremely situational Talent
which usually requires you to die specifically near enemy
Heroes to be impactful, and also requires allied Heroes to be able to
follow up on the impending
Mosh Pit.
The upside is that a Mosh Pit coming from a dead E.T.C. cannot be
interrupted. If you find yourself dying often, this
Talent may have significant payoff, especially if you manage to position
yourself right next to your opponents when you expect to die within 2 seconds.
You may need this Talent when playing with Stage Dive
against enemy teams who tend to focus E.T.C. immediately after landing,
but you can also pick it in other circumstances for similar reasons.
Alternatively, it can be used against team compositions featuring
4 melee or low-range Heroes because they will struggle to finish you off
without being caught by Death Metal immediately after,
especially if they lack mobility tools.
?
Power of the Horde
(Level 20)
E.T.C.
Cooldown: 45 seconds
Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds, increased by 2% for each other allied Hero in the area.
Power of the Horde is a strong Talent
that may be useful when you feel like your peeling tools
are not enough to keep allied Heroes alive, whether because the enemy team
has too much burst damage or mobility.
You can also use it to boost E.T.C's own survivability.
Due to being based on maximum Health, the Shield generated is more effective
on some Heroes and less effective on others, however, it is still great
for saving squishy Heroes from danger.
✔
Ride the Lightning
(Level 20)
E.T.C.
Cooldown: 70 seconds
Activate to teleport to a nearby location and deal 48 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes. The cooldown is reduced by 10 second for every enemy Hero hit, up to 50 seconds.
Ride the Lightning is a strong Talent which
can be used to instantly teleport from a position to another within range.
When doing so, E.T.C. deals damage to all enemy Heroes nearby
and Ride the Lightning's cooldown gets reduced
by 10 seconds for each enemy Hero hit, up to 50 seconds.
You can use this Talent for either offensive or defensive plays.
When in danger, you can use it to increase the distance from enemy Heroes,
preferably by teleporting across impassable terrain. When your team is ready
to follow up, you can use it as a range extender
for your Powerslide and/or for trying
to get a good Mosh Pit.
